segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The wind howling across the high ridge was so cold it made your teeth ache.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Down in the valley, Everfrost lay in pitch-black shadow. The Grand Clock's giant golden face was completely dark, but its massive brass pendulum still swung with a heavy, hollow CLANG-CLANG that rattled the snow right off the pine branches.

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: Right then,

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Pip muttered, pulling his crooked detective hat down over his pointed ears.

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: The situation has officially escalated from 'moderately troublesome' to 'thoroughly catastrophic.' We must make for my headquarters at once.

segments.speaker: hero
segments.text: Your headquarters?

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: you ask, rubbing your freezing arms.

segments.speaker: hero
segments.text: Where is that?

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: A classified location of immense strategic importance,

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Pip declared, puffing out his chest under his giant green coat.

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: The locals call it the Old Abandoned Mill by the frozen river. I call it... The Foxhole of Justice.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: He turned and trotted into the dense pine forest lining the mountain slope. You hurry after him, your boots crunching through the deep, powdery snow.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The deeper you go into the woods, the stranger it gets.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The wind isn't just whistling through the frosted needles—it’s talking.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Faint, overlapping whispers drift off the snowbanks like silver mist. If you listen closely, they aren't words about winter or snow at all.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: ...don't forget the sunscreen at the pool...

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: ...look at the red and gold leaves on the maple tree...

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: ...make a wish and blow out all eight candles...

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: ...fourth of July fireworks start at nine...

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: You stop in your tracks.

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: Pip... do you hear that?

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: Hear what?

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Pip asked, stopping and adjusting his scarf.

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: The ominous whistling of the arctic gusts? The subtle rustle of nocturnal woodland creatures? The roar of my own deductive intellect?

segments.speaker: hero
segments.text: No,

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: you say, crouching beside a glowing blue snowdrift.

segments.speaker: hero
segments.text: Listen. It's summer. It's birthdays. It's autumn. The snow is whispering memories!
